notice: Development-stage procedural gate. Metadata cannot prove cryptographic security by itself.

criteria.statement: Independent review of sender authentication, forward secrecy, rotation, post-compromise recovery and key epochs.
No long-lived GitHub or channel secrets exposed to arbitrary WebView script; independent native bridge review.
Cryptographic replay/rollback protection and verified device membership, rekey and revocation.
Verified network and metadata threat model including GitHub accounts, cellular operators and IP exposure.
Adversarial two-device tests across Wi-Fi and mobile carrier, 403/429, outages, lost devices and migration.
Third-party OWASP MASVS mobile penetration test and remediation of critical/high findings.
Verify signed 0.9.0 upgrade to candidate and Play App Signing certificate identity.
Test compromised device recovery, emergency key revocation, secure backups and source-protection runbooks.
